intervention: Use original frozen RAW100k H3 model, raw environment reward, 3D actions, same consumed four track-1 TRAIN roads and reset IDs, 512/24/6/64 MPPI; change only final planned action eval_mode=True to False to add training-mode Gaussian. Subsequent RNG consumption also changes.

performance_evidence.scope: eight full episodes on four already-consumed track-1 TRAIN roads, two repeat seeds per road; no protected or official evaluation

decision: The training-mode Gaussian H3 intervention finishes 2/8 across two repeatedly trained roads and fails the predeclared local 4/8 gate. Descriptively the historical frozen H3 no-Gaussian evaluator finished 0/8 under the same road/reset IDs, but the episodes are not matched action trajectories, and RNG consumption also changes after the first noisy action. Do not claim the Gaussian caused the training/evaluation finish gap or generalization. Next test a separate one-axis coverage hypothesis only after candidate-specific consumed-TRAIN audit, protocol freeze and safety checks.
